sources.entry: APNGb - PNG image assembler/disassembler app. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/mancunianetz/APNGb) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: APNGb is a macOS app that assembles PNG frames into animated PNG (APNG) files and splits existing APNG files back into individual PNG frames.
summary.what_it_does: The app creates an animated APNG or PNG from a series of PNG images, with optimization and compression options and control over frame delay for all or selected frames. It also offers playback options. In the other direction, it breaks an APNG or PNG file into a series of PNG images. The assembler uses inter-frame optimization (alpha-blend and dispose operations), subframes smaller than full size, dirty transparency, color type and palette optimization, and zlib, 7zip, or Zopfli compression. The README says it is built on two executables by Max Stepin, APNG Assembler and APNG Disassembler. It supports macOS 10.11 and above.
use_cases: Turn a sequence of PNG frames into an animated PNG
Extract individual frames from an APNG file
Change frame delay in an animation
how_to_run: Download the app from the link in the README (APNGb 2.0.1)
notable: Frame-level optimization for smaller APNG files, including alpha-blend and dispose operations
Per-frame or global frame delay editing
Both assembling and disassembling in one macOS app
Built on Max Stepin's APNG Assembler and Disassembler executables
caveats: macOS only; requires macOS 10.11 or later
The README does not describe build steps; it points to a download for the app
